title: EvaluatorItems
description: Shape of items.evaluation for L1-vision-regulatory-feasibility-checker-evaluator, extending the shared Phase 0 evaluator shape (S6 pattern). Scores are read from the paired generator's evaluation.md at runtime — this schema does not duplicate the rubric, only the result shape. The evaluator re-emits the generator's full result (constraints, overall_status, categories_not_applicable, viability, open_items — see the generator's output_schema.json) with this object attached under items.evaluation. v2.0 adds viability_check, since the score the generator now owns is re-derived here from the final post-fix constraints rather than accepted as reported.

hallucination.description: Lower is better — this is a rate, not a pass score

citation_completeness.description: null if the generator's evaluation.md marks this N/A

pass.description: overall_score >= the paired generator's spec.yaml quality.min_score

gate.description: Which evaluation.md Quality Gate or Reflection Checklist item this finding is about

groundedness_check.description: Whether the assessment is grounded in the actual idea and in domain facts, and whether every applicable regulator category was swept

consistent.description: false is always a fail finding — a mismatch means the assessment may have been run against the wrong idea

citations_checked_count.description: How many citations were checked against the domain KB. EXCEPTIONS-ONLY reporting: the ones that passed are carried as this count, never as per-constraint entries — a roll-call grows with the assessment and pushes the response past the output rail's payload ceiling

citation_problems.description: Only citations the domain KB contradicted or did not cover. Empty when every citation checked out

citation.description: Regulation name only — never the rationale text

uncovered_categories.description: Applicable categories present in neither constraints nor categories_not_applicable — non-empty is always a fail finding. Only the gaps are listed; categories that were covered are never enumerated

kb_declared_jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 the attached KBs declare in their #jurisdiction sections

jurisdiction_consistent.description: false is always a fail finding — see the jurisdiction audit in the prompt

out_of_jurisdiction_citations.description: Citations belonging to a country other than the resolved jurisdiction — always a fail finding, never excused as 'not covered'

belongs_to.description: The jurisdiction the cited instrument actually belongs to

national_only_constraints.description: Constraints answered only at national level where a sub-national layer also binds

viability_check.description: The score re-derived from the FINAL post-fix constraints, compared against what the generator reported. The derivation runs one way only, from the constraints to the number — never adjusted to move final_score toward a wanted side of the threshold.

reported_score.description: viability.viability_score as the generator submitted it; null if it emitted none

rederived_score.description: The lowest of rederived_weighted_score and every cap in caps_expected. This is the number emitted in items.viability

caps_expected.description: The caps the final constraints actually trigger

caps_reported.description: The caps the generator recorded. A cap in caps_expected but not here is a fail finding

consistent.description: true only when reported_score equals rederived_score and caps_reported covers caps_expected

allOf.description: An unresolved regulatory blocker can never clear the gate — if a cap fired, the score is below threshold

final_decision.description: approved = passed with no fixes needed; fixed_and_approved = failed findings were fixed and now pass; escalate_to_hitl = could not fix to a passing score. A Red or requires_legal_review constraint surviving into the final constraints array is always escalate_to_hitl, regardless of the evaluation score

allOf.description: A viability derivation that does not match what was reported cannot be recorded as approved-without-fixes
